text.section: If any installment under a premium finance agreement is not paid in full within seven days after it is due, Sundays and holidays included, the insurance premium finance company may charge and collect a default charge not to exceed five percent of the installment. The default charge shall be collected only once on any installment.

An insurance premium finance company may charge and collect a fee, not in excess of twenty dollars, for each check returned to the insurance premium finance company because the drawer had no account or insufficient funds in the payor bank.
